payload.content: Keep a roll upright and stable on the counter—the 6.5-inch freestanding paper towel holder is crafted from solid brass and uses a weighted base to stay put as you tear off sheets. {FINISH_SENTENCE} Designed as a space-saving countertop paper towel stand, it holds the roll vertically so you don’t lose valuable prep space. A felt pad under the base helps prevent scratching on granite, wood, or other surfaces. Blending contemporary lines with traditional design elements, it fits naturally with classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware from the Carolina Collection. The designer finish is made for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. No assembly required; includes the paper towel holder and is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty—an easy alternative to an under cabinet paper towel holder when you want flexible placement.
